title: %urlDecode — Decode a percent-encoded string
purpose: Reverse percent-encoding, turning a URL component back into plain text.
notes: Inverse of %urlEncode: %20 becomes a space, %26 an ampersand, and so on.
A malformed escape (such as %zz) decodes to ~ (null) rather than raising an error.

avoid.why: an invalid percent escape yields ~, not partial output
